It absorbs flavors beautifully, making it perfect for slow-cooked rajma dishes. 😋 Rich, creamy texture after cooking 💗 Great for slow-cooked curries and stews 🌱 100% organic and naturally grown

products.name: Organic Sonamasuri Brown Rice
products.description: Grown in Andhra Pradesh, India, 24 Mantra Sonamasuri Brown Rice is a whole-grain option that retains its bran layer, providing a rich, slightly nutty flavour. This unpolished rice offers a satisfying texture and can be used in a variety of everyday meals. A great option for those looking for a wholesome diet without artificial additives. 😋 Retains Bran Layer – A wholesome, unpolished rice variety 💪🏻 Rich in Fiber & Nutrients – A great addition to a balanced diet ✨ Authentic & Organic – No chemicals, just pure, farm-fresh goodness

products.name: Organic Wheat Dhaliya
products.description: Made from carefully sourced wheat from Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra , our Organic Wheat Dhaliya is a wholesome choice for light yet filling meals. Coarsely ground for a hearty texture, it’s ideal for both sweet and savory recipes like porridge or upma. Packed with the natural goodness of whole wheat and nothing else, this is clean, organic comfort food at its best. 🌿 Made from 100% organic wheat 💗 Great for light, nutritious meals 😋 Versatile ingredient for both sweet and savory dishes
